visual_action: A montage of clips shows large groups of people, identified as Venezuelans, celebrating in various outdoor locations, including a street rally and a gas station. People are cheering, dancing, singing, and waving Venezuelan and American flags. One clip shows a couple indoors with a Venezuelan flag and a "TRUMP SAVE AMERICA" flag. Another is a selfie video of an excited young man. A flag with an image of Donald Trump as Superman is shown attached to a car. The video ends with a black and white logo for "THE WHITE HOUSE".

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The on-screen text reads "& Thank President Trump". He is also thanked in the audio: "Uncle Trump, thank you!" and "Thank you Donald Trump!" A flag shows his face on Superman's body.

cast.name: Nicolás Maduro
cast.evidence: The on-screen text reads "Celebrate the Capture of Maduro". A speaker says, "Maduro's regime is gone!"

cast.name: Venezuelans
cast.evidence: The on-screen text identifies the celebrants as "Venezuelans in U.S. & Abroad". People are shown throughout the video holding Venezuelan flags and celebrating.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video is posted by the @whitehouse account and ends with a title card reading "THE WHITE HOUSE".

on_screen_text.text: Venezuelans in U.S. & Abroad Celebrate the Capture of Maduro & Thank President Trump

spoken_summary: The video features a collection of audio from celebrations. People are heard singing the patriotic song "Viva Venezuela" and chanting "USA! USA!". Several individuals speak excitedly in Spanish with English subtitles provided. One man says, "Maduro's regime is gone! Uncle Trump, thank you!" Another person says, "Thank you Donald Trump! My country is free now!"
audio_music: The video features the celebratory and patriotic song "Viva Venezuela" by Un Solo Pueblo, interspersed with the raw audio of crowds cheering, singing the same song, and chanting. The overall effect is energetic, joyous, and triumphant.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various scenes of celebration, creating a high-energy and dynamic feel.
manipulation_or_satire: A flag is shown that depicts Donald Trump's head photoshopped onto the body of the superhero Superman. This is used to portray Trump in a heroic, savior-like manner.
central_claim: Donald Trump is responsible for the capture of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, leading to widespread, grateful celebrations among Venezuelans who now consider their country free.
intended_effect: To generate feelings of pride and gratitude towards Donald Trump and his administration, portraying him as a liberator who delivers on foreign policy promises.
